## Build

The top-level build script is `CMakeLists.txt` at the repository root (`cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)`).

```bash
cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
cmake --build build -j"$(nproc)"
sudo cmake --install build
```
